title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Free Window, Cancellation Ladder and No-Show Amounts
content:
Giving a rental up and failing to collect it are priced separately on each of the six Car Rental Rate Classes. The published amounts are set out below.

| Rate class | Free cancellation hours | Flat cancellation charge (USD) | No-show charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 0 | 60.00 | 95.00 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 24 | 50.00 | 75.00 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 48 | 35.00 | 55.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 48 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 24 | 0.00 | 45.00 |

The free cancellation column is the number of hours before collection by which a cancellation carries no charge. The flat charge is the class's flat charge for a cancellation outside the free window, and the no-show charge is the amount where the renter never collects the vehicle.

**The cancellation ladder.** Each class also publishes its cancellation charge as a share of the rental total, keyed by how far ahead of collection the cancellation lands.

| Rate class | Cancellation ladder, as a percentage of the rental total |
|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 14 or more days 100 · 13 to 3 days 100 · 2 to 1 days 100 · same day 100 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 14 or more days 25 · 13 to 3 days 50 · 2 to 1 days 75 · same day 100 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 14 or more days 0 · 13 to 3 days 0 · 2 to 1 days 25 · same day 50 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 14 or more days 0 · 13 to 3 days 0 · 2 to 1 days 0 · same day 25 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 14 or more days 0 · 13 to 3 days 0 · 2 to 1 days 0 · same day 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 14 or more days 0 · 13 to 3 days 0 · 2 to 1 days 0 · same day 20 |

**Reading the two together.** The Pay Now Saver Rate publishes 0 free cancellation hours and a ladder standing at 100 in every band, so nothing on that class falls outside the top of its ladder. The Pay At Counter Flex Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate publish 24 free hours, the Inclusive Flex Rate and the Premium Inclusive Rate 48. The Premium Inclusive Rate publishes 0 in every ladder band and a flat charge of 0, and its no-show charge is likewise 0; the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate publishes 0 in the three forward bands and 20 on the same day. The no-show charges run 0, 95, 75, 55, 0 and 45 down the six classes.
